request.description: One native pixel art fantasy enemy STILL for Dungeon Matcher, full body three-quarter combat stance looking slightly viewer-left, transparent background. Crisp ONE-source-pixel #0A0D11 contours, NO antialias, gradient, dithering, grain, text, ground shadow or scenery. Broad connected 2-3-tone top-left shaded material shapes; compact whimsical expressive identity. Keep every extremity inside 2-pixel side margins. Matte charcoal/navy iron, muted leather, small brass, luminous orange ONLY in ore sockets. Elder chunky DWARF workshop master with rust-gray beard split into TWO FORKS, welding goggles above eyes, riveted navy overalls and belt with two bolts and ammo spool. Holds large OPEN-JAW MECHANICAL WRENCH, small embedded orange crystal by its gear hinge. Blueprint roll at hip. Commanding face, short planted legs, face readable. No helmet clone, staff, firearm, sword or turret fused to body.

style_image.usage_description: Style and native scale only, shared crisp contour and broad material shading. Different identity, silhouette, headgear and equipment as described; do NOT copy pilot or pickaxe.
